=== cpu.QueryCPUUtilizationAgg

      @end = time.Time 2026-01-02T08:06:40Z
      @metricNames = []string []string{"system.cpu.utilization", "system.cpu.usage", "process.cpu.usage"}
      @start = time.Time 2026-01-02T02:06:40Z
      @tenantID = uint32 0x7

=== cpu.QueryCPUUtilizationByInstance
  [0] Select: WITH fps AS ( SELECT fingerprint, host, pod, container, service FROM optikk.metrics_series AS mr PREWHERE tenant_id = @tenantID AND timestamp BETWEEN @start AND @end AND metric_name IN @metricNames WHERE mr.service != '' GROUP BY fingerprint, host, pod, container, service ) SELECT r.host AS host, r.pod AS pod, r.container AS container, r.service AS service, m.metric_name AS metric_name, if(sum(m.val_count) = 0, 0, sum(m.val_sum) / sum(m.val_count)) AS value FROM optikk.metrics_5m AS m INNER JOIN fps AS r ON m.fingerprint = r.fingerprint PREWHERE m.tenant_id = @tenantID AND m.metric_name IN @metricNames AND m.timestamp BETWEEN @start AND @end GROUP BY host, pod, container, service, metric_name ORDER BY service, pod LIMIT 500
      @end = time.Time 2026-01-02T08:06:40Z
      @metricNames = []string []string{"system.cpu.utilization", "system.cpu.usage", "process.cpu.usage"}
      @start = time.Time 2026-01-02T02:06:40Z
      @tenantID = uint32 0x7

=== hosts.QueryHostUtilization
  [0] Select: WITH fps AS ( SELECT fingerprint, host FROM optikk.metrics_series AS mr PREWHERE tenant_id = @tenantID AND timestamp BETWEEN @start AND @end AND metric_name IN @metricNames WHERE mr.host != '' AND NOT (metric_name = @cpuUtil AND attributes['state'] != 'idle') AND NOT (metric_name = @memUtil AND attributes['state'] != 'used') GROUP BY fingerprint, host ) SELECT r.host AS host, m.metric_name AS metric_name, if(m.metric_name = @cpuUtil, 1 - sum(m.val_sum) / sum(m.val_count), sum(m.val_sum) / sum(m.val_count)) AS value FROM optikk.metrics_5m AS m INNER JOIN fps AS r ON m.fingerprint = r.fingerprint PREWHERE m.tenant_id = @tenantID AND m.metric_name IN @metricNames AND m.timestamp BETWEEN @start AND @end GROUP BY host, metric_name ORDER BY host, metric_name LIMIT 500
      @cpuUtil = string "system.cpu.utilization"
      @end = time.Time 2026-01-02T08:06:40Z
      @memUtil = string "system.memory.utilization"
      @metricNames = []string []string{"system.cpu.utilization", "system.cpu.usage", "process.cpu.usage", "system.memory.utilization", "jvm.memory.used", "jvm.memory.max", "system.disk.utilization", "disk.free", "disk.total"}
      @start = time.Time 2026-01-02T02:06:40Z
      @tenantID = uint32 0x7

=== hosts.QueryHostSpans
  [0] Select: SELECT if(host != '', host, @unknownHost) AS host, any(environment) AS zone, sum(request_count) AS request_total, sumIf(request_count, (status_code_string = 'ERROR')) AS error_total, toFloat32(quantileTDigestMerge(0.99)(latency_state)) AS p99_ms, max(timestamp) AS last_seen FROM optikk.span_stats_5m PREWHERE tenant_id = @tenantID AND timestamp BETWEEN @start AND @end AND service = @serviceName GROUP BY host ORDER BY request_total DESC LIMIT 200
      @end = time.Time 2026-01-02T08:06:40Z
      @serviceName = string "checkout"
      @start = time.Time 2026-01-02T02:06:40Z
      @tenantID = uint32 0x7
      @unknownHost = string "unknown"

=== fleet.QueryFleetPods

      @defaultUnknown = string "unknown"
      @end = time.Time 2026-01-02T08:06:40Z
      @hostFilter = string ""
      @maxFleetPods = uint64 0xc8
      @start = time.Time 2026-01-02T02:06:40Z
      @tenantID = uint32 0x7

=== hostdetail.QuerySeries/gauge
  [0] Select: WITH fps AS ( SELECT fingerprint, any(temporality) AS temporality, if(attributes['state'] = '', 'cpu', attributes['state']) AS label FROM optikk.metrics_series PREWHERE tenant_id = @tenantID AND timestamp BETWEEN @start AND @end AND metric_name IN @metricNames WHERE host = @scopeVal GROUP BY fingerprint, label ) SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 300 SECOND) AS time_bucket, fps.label AS series, if(sum(m.val_count) = 0, 0, sum(m.val_sum) / sum(m.val_count)) AS value FROM optikk.metrics_5m AS m INNER JOIN fps ON m.fingerprint = fps.fingerprint PREWHERE m.tenant_id = @tenantID AND m.metric_name IN @metricNames AND m.timestamp BETWEEN @start AND @end GROUP BY time_bucket, series ORDER BY time_bucket ASC, series ASC LIMIT @maxRows
      @bucketGrainSec = int64 300
      @end = time.Time 2026-01-02T08:06:40Z
      @maxRows = uint64 0x2710
      @metricNames = []string []string{"system.cpu.utilization"}
      @scopeVal = string "node-a"
      @start = time.Time 2026-01-02T02:06:40Z
      @tenantID = uint32 0x7

=== hostdetail.QuerySeries/rate
  [0] Select: WITH fps AS ( SELECT fingerprint, any(temporality) AS temporality, trim(concat(attributes['device'], ' ', attributes['direction'])) AS label FROM optikk.metrics_series PREWHERE tenant_id = @tenantID AND timestamp BETWEEN @start AND @end AND metric_name IN @metricNames WHERE host = @scopeVal GROUP BY fingerprint, label ) SELECT toStartOfInterval(timestamp, INTERVAL 300 SECOND) AS time_bucket, fps.label AS series, sum(if(fps.temporality = 'Delta', m.val_sum, greatest(m.val_max - m.val_min, 0))) / @bucketGrainSec AS value FROM optikk.metrics_5m AS m INNER JOIN fps ON m.fingerprint = fps.fingerprint PREWHERE m.tenant_id = @tenantID AND m.metric_name IN @metricNames AND m.timestamp BETWEEN @start AND @end GROUP BY time_bucket, series ORDER BY time_bucket ASC, series ASC LIMIT @maxRows
      @bucketGrainSec = int64 300
      @end = time.Time 2026-01-02T08:06:40Z
      @maxRows = uint64 0x2710
      @metricNames = []string []string{"system.network.io"}
      @scopeVal = string "node-a"
      @start = time.Time 2026-01-02T02:06:40Z
      @tenantID = uint32 0x7
